description: This file defines the GatewayConnectConfig struct, which encapsulates configuration details related to connecting to a gateway in the iOS app. It includes properties such as URL, stable ID, TLS parameters, tokens, password, and connection options, along with a computed property for deriving a stable identifier.

methods.name: effectiveStableID
methods.description: A computed property that returns a stable identifier for the gateway connection, falling back to the URL's absolute string if the stableID is empty after trimming.
